$comment: What an editor writes for one machine or one user -- never tracked (ADR-001 amendment 16.12). Taken from github/gitignore (Global/JetBrains.gitignore, VisualStudio.gitignore), the shared reference for both: `under` names a directory an editor keeps its state in and the paths inside it that are per-user or generated (what it shares -- code styles, inspection profiles, run configurations -- is not listed); `names` are per-user files wherever they are. `shared` are paths inside one that the editor itself keeps for the team -- a JetBrains project dictionary is dictionaries/project.xml; a user's is named after the user.
